rules: History protection: history items are never demoted, removed, or re-scored by any reranker.
Non-Len3 protection: users outside the exact Len3 bucket are never modified.
Fallback: if any stage fails or violates a guard, keep the parent (V23 anchor) output unchanged.
Frozen hashes: anchor manifests and submitted artifacts are hash-frozen; any hash mismatch invalidates the deployment record.
The champion strategy is frozen; improvements require a new anchored branch, never in-place edits.
transfer_policy: These safety patterns are portable; A2 user ids, item ids, scores, checkpoints, and weights are not and must never enter B2.
